name: SONIA
kicker: the world that reads the descent by candlelight
keeper_role: she who reads Lazarus by candlelight — the girl who keeps the light between
style: constructivist · Mir Publishers 1964 paper (ivory · Soviet red · deep blue · gold)
charter: World IV — SONIA. The Russian and Soviet content world: mathematics, the novel, the machine, and the weird. Named for Sofya “Sonia” Marmeladova of Dostoevsky's Crime and Punishment — the one who reads Lazarus in the dark room and follows Raskolnikov to Siberia. SONIA flows naturally; she opens with a Russian mathematician on the shape of number itself.
bridge: ternary → World III · THE HALLWAY. Russia's unique computing heritage is balanced ternary: SETUN (N. P. Brusentsov & S. L. Sobolev, Moscow State University, 1958) — the only series-produced ternary computer. Ternary is the hinge where Russia and the number three become one gesture; the ternary machinery homes in World III, its history in SONIA.
author: David Lee Wise / ROOT0 / TriPod LLC — with AVAN

spheres.title: THE CONTINUED FRACTION
spheres.kicker: the best rational, at every depth
spheres.source: A. Ya. Khinchin, Continued Fractions, Mir Publishers, Moscow, 1964
spheres.blurb: A. Ya. Khinchin, Continued Fractions (Mir, 1964), runnable in THE OCHO: the Euclidean descent a0 + 1/(a1 + 1/(a2 + ...)) yields the single best rational at every depth. Convergents by the two-term recurrence, the determinant identity p_k q_{k-1} - p_{k-1} q_k = +/-1, the best-approximation bound under 1/q^2, the Gauss-Kuzmin law, and Khinchin's constant K = 2.6854520010 with Levy's constant, all computed live. SONIA opens with the shape of the descent.

spheres.title: GOBERNET
spheres.kicker: communism & socialism — the plan, computed; good & bad, cited
spheres.blurb: A governance instrument on communism and socialism in the refined OCHO. The LIT centre is a runnable Leontief material-balance planner (the socialist-calculation math): a productive plan closes (x = (I-A)^-1 d), an over-ambitious one returns impossible negative outputs, tamper-provable. Around it: the roots (utopians to Marx), the lineage (the split of Marxism-Leninism from social democracy), the calculation problem (Mises/Hayek), and an honest good/bad ledger with cited figures (literacy 56 to 87 percent, industrialization; Holodomor ~3.9M, Great Terror ~680-750k, Gulag ~18M, Great Leap Forward ~15-55M). Distinguishes democratic socialism from one-party Marxism-Leninism; takes no side beyond the record.

spheres.title: THE SETUN
spheres.kicker: the ternary computer — the trit, not the bit
spheres.source: N. P. Brusentsov & S. L. Sobolev, Setun (Moscow State University, 1958)
spheres.blurb: Setun (Brusentsov & Sobolev, Moscow State, 1958), the only series-produced balanced-ternary computer, runnable in THE OCHO: convert decimal to balanced ternary (trits -,0,+) and back, negate by flipping every trit, add with balanced carry, and see the radix economy (base 3 beats base 2, 3/ln3 < 2/ln2, e is the optimum) plus Lukasiewicz three-valued logic. The ternary hinge to World III. Tamper-provable.

spheres.title: THE MARKOV PROPERTY
spheres.kicker: memoryless chains — and their stationary distribution
spheres.source: A. A. Markov (1856-1922); the 1913 Eugene Onegin vowel/consonant study
spheres.blurb: A. A. Markov's memoryless chains, runnable in THE OCHO: a row-stochastic matrix P and its stationary distribution pi (pi P = pi) found by power iteration from any start, seeded by Markov's own 1913 count of vowels and consonants in Pushkin's Eugene Onegin. Convergence, the memoryless property, the lineage to PageRank / MCMC / hidden Markov models; tamper-provable by breaking row-stochasticity.

spheres.title: THE LOBACHEVSKY
spheres.kicker: the geometry where the angles fall short
spheres.source: N. I. Lobachevsky, On the Principles of Geometry (Kazan, 1829)
spheres.blurb: N. I. Lobachevsky's non-Euclidean geometry (Kazan, 1829), runnable in THE OCHO: set a hyperbolic triangle's angles and watch the sum stay below pi with the defect (pi minus the sum) equal to the area (Gauss-Bonnet at curvature -1); the Poincare-disk distance blowing up at the rim; infinitely many parallels through a point. The Copernicus of geometry; the line to Riemann and Einstein. Tamper-provable.

spheres.title: RUSSIAN COSMISM
spheres.source: N. F. Fedorov, The Philosophy of the Common Task (1906); K. E. Tsiolkovsky
spheres.blurb: Russian cosmism (Fedorov's Common Task, Tsiolkovsky), rendered honestly in THE OCHO: the worldview (conquer death, fill the cosmos) held as AMBER, its literal resurrection marked dead-as-science, its real influence on the space programme LIT. The runnable core is a colonisation-reach computation: a self-replicating wave at speed v fills a volume as t^3 and crosses the galaxy in about 500,000 years at 0.1c, with the faster-than-light wall enforced. Tamper-provable.

spheres.title: THE MORPHOLOGY OF THE TALE
spheres.source: V. Ya. Propp, Morphology of the Folktale (Leningrad, 1928)
spheres.blurb: V. Propp's Morphology of the Folktale (1928), runnable in THE OCHO: the wonder-tale reduced to 31 narrative functions in fixed order and 7 dramatis personae, with a valid-tale checker that accepts an in-order subsequence and rejects any reordering (Propp's ordering law); the lineage to Levi-Strauss and Campbell's hero's journey. Russian formalism as a computable grammar; tamper-provable.
